maize.source: FAO GAEZ v5, RES05-SXX/SIX/YXX mapsets, crop code MZE, scenario HIST/AGERA5/LRLM/HP0120. Files: https://storage.googleapis.com/fao-gismgr-gaez-v5-data/DATA/GAEZ-V5/MAPSET/RES05-SXX/GAEZ-V5.RES05-SXX.HP0120.AGERA5.HIST.MZE.LRLM.tif | https://storage.googleapis.com/fao-gismgr-gaez-v5-data/DATA/GAEZ-V5/MAPSET/RES05-SIX/GAEZ-V5.RES05-SIX.HP0120.AGERA5.HIST.MZE.LRLM.tif | https://storage.googleapis.com/fao-gismgr-gaez-v5-data/DATA/GAEZ-V5/MAPSET/RES05-YXX/GAEZ-V5.RES05-YXX.HP0120.AGERA5.HIST.MZE.LRLM.tif
maize.retrieval_note: suitability_class derived from suitability_index using GAEZ v5 Module V's published class-boundary percentages (VS>=80, S>=60, MS>=40, mS>=20, vmS>0, NS=0), NOT by decoding the RES05-SIX raster's raw integer legend (FAO does not publish that legend; raw RES05-SIX pixel value recorded here for cross-check only: 6.0). SXX raster units are suitability index x100 (0-10000 scale); divided by 100 here. YXX units are kg/ha dry matter, rainfed low-input historical (2001-2020) scenario -- this is GAEZ's modeled attainable-yield CEILING, not an observed or variety-specific yield.
